name: ICT NY Kill Zone Auto Trading

template.name: ICT NY Kill Zone Auto Trading
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and low < open and close - low >= {p0} * atr(high,low,close,{p1})
template.notes: A five-bar high break with a rejection wick approximates a fair-value-gap/order-block long setup. Kill-zone time and exact multi-candle gap/order-block geometry are unavailable; documented 30/60 point protection is not a percentage.
